answer: Unique-work conservation receipts.** Each identity must submit a task output whose exact content is withheld from all public channels and logged only as a sealed digest. A verifier checks that no prior identity has ever produced the same underlying work, treating repeats as duplicates and rejecting them. This forces every new identity to generate genuinely novel output, like fresh timber that cannot be resold. The registry maintains a global atlas of sealed digests for cross-checking.
